title: Running Your AI Agent Team, Conversation 1: The week before
description:
Dave's Tuesday, hour by hour, from two church texts at ten to seven to eighteen unfinished wreath signs at bed. No AI until the last five minutes: one picture of a reply drafted overnight, waiting to be read and sent, and the one thing to do tonight: write your own day down and sort it into piles.

First conversation of the audiobook Running Your AI Agent Team. Planned and drafted with Anthropic Claude, extensively edited. Rabi's voice is his authorised synthetic voice. Dave is an invented character voiced by AI.
